Azure Government note: the Analytics-pane Forecast feature is Verify for Gov. Validate visual support, tenant policy, and data residency before requiring it.

When available:
1. Add a line chart with Date on the X axis and Sales Amount as the value.
2. Enable Forecast in the Analytics pane.
3. Review the confidence interval band and note the underlying exponential smoothing assumptions.

Gov-safe alternate path (used on this page): the line chart plots Sales Amount alongside 'Sales Rolling 90 Days' (a rolling average) and 'Sales Prior Year' (a same-period-last-year comparison) — both already built as Lab 02 time-intelligence measures. These give trend and seasonality context without relying on a forecasting algorithm or an AI-classified visual.

Tasks: 1) Identify where actual Sales Amount diverges most from the rolling average. 2) Compare year-over-year using Sales Prior Year. 3) Discuss what a forecast visual would add beyond these two reference lines, and what governance question you would ask before turning it on for a Gov customer.
